title: Task
description: A single task entity as stored in Azure Cosmos DB. The 'id' field also serves as the Cosmos DB partition key.

id.description: Server-generated UUID v4. Also used as the Cosmos DB partition key.

organizationId.description: UUID of the organisation that owns this task. Used for multi-tenant data isolation.

title.description: Short, human-readable title of the task.

description.description: Optional longer description of the task.

dueDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time string for the task deadline.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

tags.description: Optional free-form labels associated with the task.

customFieldValues.description: Map of fieldId → value for any dynamic custom fields configured in GlobalSettings.

createdAt.description: Server-assigned ISO 8601 timestamp of when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Server-assigned ISO 8601 timestamp of the last mutation.
